meta.title: Reschedule Event is offered on an upcoming RFQ
warnings: moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen
moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen

steps.note: Open the preconfigured upcoming RFQ event.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case configuration.
Reach the RFQ stage page where its Settings menu is available.
Open the RFQ stage Settings menu.
Verify Reschedule Event is offered and clickable for an upcoming RFQ.
Select Reschedule Event to verify that its window opens.
Assert the reschedule window is open before any confirmation.
Cancel the reschedule operation so the event remains unchanged.
Verify the dialog closed after cancellation.
